name: College of Science Summer Camps (Explore Science camps)
what_you_do: These are week-long residential science camps. They have hands-on labs and experiments. In 2026, high school camps were Explore Science for rising 9th and 10th graders. Explore Life Science and Explore Physical Science were for rising 11th and 12th graders.
grades: Rising 9th to 12th (Explore Science 9-10; Life and Physical Science camps 11-12)
who_can_apply: Rising high school students in the grade band for each camp. No GPA or residency rule appears on the pages I read.
pay_detail: 2026 price $1,150 per residential camp ($700 for the day camp for rising 7th-8th). Camp fees cover instruction, supplies, room and board; need-based scholarships are available in the application.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application portal opened January 2026; deadline for first round of applications March 2. Offers of admission and scholarships made by March 16; accepted campers have until March 30 to pay fees (minus scholarships).
how_to_apply: Register through the camp application link on the College of Science camps page; apply for a scholarship inside the form. Cancellation refund minus a $30 fee until 4 weeks before camp.
notes: Explore Science rising 9-10 camp was listed as full in 2026. Questions: explorescicamp@vt.edu. Not a job, so no work permit.
